what_this_is: Cells that fail the >=0.90 bar because the WITNESS AND THE REFERENCE ARE DIFFERENT EDITIONS, not because the transcription is wrong. Each entry records the visual read that establishes the transcription is correct, and the reference split that establishes the divergence. §13 Q21.
the_rule_this_does_not_break: A flagged cell STAYS OPEN and STILL BLOCKS. It is counted as failing everywhere it is counted at all. This register explains a failure; it never excuses one. Nothing here is subtracted from any denominator — that is the laundering the house rule forbids, and the whole point of writing the evidence down is that the next reader can check it rather than take the word 'divergence' on trust.

flags.our_text: In the ſecond month, the ſeauen and twentieth day of the month the earth was dried.
flags.visual_read: jp2-S06 p51 prints, plainly: `14. In (b) the ſecond month , the ſeauen and twentieth day of the month the earth was dried.` Read at 2600px on 2026-07-31. The `(b)` is an annotation anchor and is correctly excluded from the verse text per ground-truth/GUIDELINES.md. Our transcription of this leaf is CORRECT.
flags.the_divergence: The scores split exactly along the edition line, which is the evidence that this is collation and not recognition: the MODERN references agree with what S6 prints (sabates_a 0.9877, madueke_b 0.9877) while the 1609 ARCHAIC references disagree (s_dismas 0.8765, odr_com 0.8889). odr_com reads `In the second moneth, the seuen & twentyth day of the moneth`. S6 is the 1635 SECOND edition; it sets `month` for `moneth` and `ſeauen and twentieth` for `ſeuen & twentyth`.
flags.why_no_recognizer_closes_it: R3 was run on this cell twice and moved it 0.876 -> 0.864, i.e. AWAY from the bar, because the vision model modernizes and the archaic references are the governing arm. There is no reading of these pixels that satisfies both editions at once — the pixels say `month` and the governing reference says `moneth`.
flags.what_would_resolve_it: A collation decision that is Sir's to make, not the pipeline's: either the governing reference for a 1635-edition witness becomes a 1635-edition reference, or the standard admits an edition-divergence verdict distinct from a transcription failure. Both are policy, and the cell stays OPEN until one is chosen.
